selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first locate powered rails in the environment, which will be placed as part of a minecart track leading to a structure built with acacia stairs. Finding the powered rail trail guides the player to the structure where they must then mine acacia stairs. This creates a natural exploration-then-action dependency: the powered rails serve as a navigational landmark/path that leads to the acacia stairs location. Both tasks are visually observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just exploration and block-breaking. The powered rail is distinctive (gold-colored rail) and acacia stairs have a unique orange-tinted wood appearance, making both identifiable without expert knowledge.

edges.reason: Powered rails form a track leading to the acacia stairs structure; finding the rails guides the player to the mining location

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward and visually observe the powered rails. Target is set to [0, 0, 13] (the second-to-last rail near the acacia structure) with max_distance=5. This requires the player to walk ~8+ blocks forward from spawn (which is at ~[0, 0, 0]) before entering the 5-block trigger radius. The facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward the rail line. This fixes the original issue where max_distance=16 with target [0, 0, 9] would have triggered immediately at spawn.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia stairs causes the block to drop itself as an item that enters the player's inventory. Acacia stairs are wooden stairs that can be broken by hand (no tool required) and always drop themselves. The player starts with no acacia_stairs in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms the block was successfully mined and picked up. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the player obtained the item.

scene_description: A line of 7 powered rails on stone blocks leads south from spawn toward a tiered acacia structure. Two redstone torches at Z=7 and Z=11 power nearby rails for visual distinctiveness. The acacia structure spans Z=15-18, X=-3 to 3, with acacia stairs forming the stepped front face at heights 0-2, acacia planks as fill, acacia logs as the back wall, and a top row of acacia stairs as a roof edge. The player follows the rail track to discover the powered rails, then mines acacia stairs from the structure.
task_text: Follow the powered rail track ahead of you. Once you find the powered rails, continue to the acacia wood structure at the end of the track and mine one of the acacia stairs blocks.
design_notes: Powered rails at Z=3,5,7,9,11,13,15 on stone blocks guide the player south. Redstone torches at [1,0,7] and [1,0,11] power nearby rails for visual distinctiveness. Acacia structure spans Z=15-18, X=-3 to 3, with stairs at the front face (Z=15,16,17) at heights 0,1,2. Back wall of acacia logs at Z=18 goes up to Y=3. Top row of acacia stairs at Y=3 spans the whole structure. Player can mine any of the 28 acacia stair blocks.
